_comment: Hydration Tracker eval scenarios. There is NO model here — hydration_eval.py is the reference implementation of the rules engine (docs/hydration-engine-contract.md §1). Each scenario lists inputs and the expected target range/status; the harness also runs cross-scenario relational + nudge assertions. 'min_ml'/'max_ml' are loose physiological-sanity bounds, not exact labels.
constants_ref: docs/hydration-engine-contract.md §1 (BASE_PER_KG=33, T0=20, K_HEAT=25, K_ACT=12, FLOOR=1500, CEILING=4000)

scenarios.name: cool_sedentary
scenarios.expect: baseline only; cold so no heat term; no activity

scenarios.name: hot_vigorous_workout
scenarios.expect: uncapped sum >4L -> clamped to CEILING, safetyClamp negative

scenarios.name: hazy_high_aqi
scenarios.expect: heat + light activity + 300mL low-confidence AQI bump

scenarios.name: hot_humid_rest
scenarios.expect: no activity; humidity amplifies heat term ~+19%

scenarios.name: steps_fallback
scenarios.expect: no activeMinutes -> steps fallback (7000 over base -> 70 LIGHT min)

scenarios.name: light_small_elderly
scenarios.expect: small mass + age 0.90 + female 0.95 -> under floor -> clamped up to FLOOR

scenarios.name: missing_weather
scenarios.expect: no temp/RH -> assume 20C/50% (heat term 0); confidence downgraded
